description:
Family A of the residual 6 (split from fz-go4.18.3.2 after diagnosis disproved the input-merge hypothesis). Tests: compiler2_native_program_adapts_delivered_calls_from_callee_return_lanes, compiler2_native_program_carries_published_callable_boundary_targets_into_closure_calls.

ROOT CAUSE (type-identity layer — violates the fz-hwn.27 canonical addressed-arrow invariant)
executable_key_for_transport_position (transport.rs:1404) reconstructs an ExecutableKey from a transport position's ExecutableSymbol via ActivationKey::from_inputs, which canonically RE-ADDRESSES inputs. But the symbol was minted from a real executable key whose input type is NON-canonically addressed. Proven for fn 185 input[1] (the Enum.take reducer-continuation union {:halt,{[T],int}} | {:cont,{[T],int}} | {:cont,{[T],int}}): the symbol's shared var is addressed a1_1_0_e (no union-variant discriminator) while from_inputs produces a1_u0_1_0_e -> distinct interned Ty ids (e.g. Ty(170) vs Ty(185)). ROUNDTRIP MISMATCH is deterministic when the union arises; once==twice (from_inputs is idempotent on its own canonical output -> canonical form is a stable fixpoint).
CONSEQUENCE CHAIN: reconstructed seed key != real demanded executable -> transport-component cone never contains the anchor's exact executable -> shape graph never anchors the ExecutableInput position -> degenerate single-position component -> produce_transport_shape_product records TransportShapeFact::Absent -> position absent from transport_shapes().keys() -> omitted from input_positions -> native (native.rs:407) hits required-but-None -> "omitted semantic input N". Schedule-dependent because which continuation union alternatives accumulate into fn 185's input depends on wake order.
backend.rs:427 has the IDENTICAL vulnerable reconstruction.

FIX DIRECTION (HIGH BLAST RADIUS — touches all activation keying/dispatch/surfaces; design carefully, likely needs owner input)
Guarantee every ExecutableKey arrow is CANONICALLY addressed at mint time so the reconstruction round-trips (a1_1_0_e must already be the canonical a1_u0_1_0_e, i.e. union-of-tuples shared vars carry the variant discriminator). Then executable_key_for_transport_position round-trips by construction. Correct-by-construction, not a reconstruction-site patch.
TESTS: a round-trip-invariant test (mint key -> to symbol -> executable_key_for_transport_position == original) over union-input executables; a union-of-tuples-shared-var canonicalization unit test; schedule-independence over the 2 fixtures; 0 failed across >=3 fresh full runs.
GUARDRAILS: no legacy revival; no test weakening; do NOT patch the two reconstruction sites to paper over non-canonical input — fix the addressing at mint. If blast radius is too large for one commit, decompose with proof.
title: Family A: canonicalize activation-key arrow addressing so executable_key_for_transport_position round-trips
